company.description: GV20 Therapeutics develops antibody therapeutics for the treatment of cancer. The company focuses on building a pipeline of first-in-class and differentiated antibody drugs targeting oncology indications. It integrates artificial intelligence, genomics, and disease biology to identify and optimize therapeutic candidates. GV20 Therapeutics advances these antibodies through preclinical and clinical development as oncology drug products. Its work is aimed at providing new therapeutic options for patients through targeted biologic treatments.
